[Intro]
[E]

[Verse 1]
[E]Wednesday
[Bm7]morning at
[F#m7]five o'clock
as the day
[C#m7]begins
[F#7]
[A]Silently
closing her
[B7]bedroom door
[A]Lea-ving the note
that she
[B7]hoped would say
more She goes

[Verse 2]
[E]down-
[Bm7]stairs to the
[F#m7]kitchen
clutching her
[C#m7]handkerchief
[F#7]
[A]Quietly
turning the back
[B7]door key
[A]Stepping out-
side she is
[B7]free

[Chorus]
[E]She
Is
leaving
Home
[E9]
[C#m]She's leaving
home after
[F#7]living alone
For so
[C#m]many years
[F#7]

[Verse 3]
[E]Father
[Bm7]snores as his
[F#m7]wife gets
into her
[C#m7]dressing gown
[F#7]
[A]Picks up the
letter that's
[B7]lying there
[A]Standing a-
lone at the
[B7]top of the stairs
She breaks

[Verse 4]
[E]down and
[Bm7]cries to her
[F#m7]husband
"Daddy our
[C#m7]baby's gone
[F#7]
[A]Why would she treat
us so
[B7]thoughtlessly?
[A]How could she do
this to
[B7]me?"

[Chorus]
[E]She
Is
leaving
Home
[E9]
[C#m]She's leaving
home after
[F#7]living alone
For so
[C#m]many years
[F#7]

[Verse 5]
[E]Friday
[Bm7]morning at
[F#m7]nine o'clock
she is
[C#m7]far away
[F#7]
[A]Waiting to keep
the appoint
[B7]ment she made
[A]Meeting a man
from the
[B7]motor trade

[Chorus]
[E]She
Is
having
Fun
[E9]
[C#m]Something in-
side that was
[F#7]always denied
For so
[C#m]many years
[F#7]

[Outro]
[C#m]She's
leaving
[F#7]home
[A]
[E]
title: She's Leaving Home
